stories.title: US sanctions forced Xinjiang cotton to adapt, but survival comes at a cost

en.title: US sanctions forced Xinjiang cotton to adapt, but survival comes at a cost
en.summary: US sanctions targeting Xinjiang's cotton industry have prompted changes in farming practices. A technician in Awati county describes how manual cotton cultivation required intensive labour, with planting and harvesting being time-consuming processes yielding modest quantities per unit of land.

stories.title: Trump defence chief says US slashed number of generals and admirals by 20%

en.title: Trump defence chief says US slashed number of generals and admirals by 20%
en.summary: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a 20 percent reduction in the number of generals and admirals, characterizing the cuts as aimed at accountability and military focus on war-fighting capabilities.

stories.title: US targets China’s steel capacity at G20 days after Xi’s state visit

en.title: US targets China's steel capacity at G20 days after Xi's state visit
en.summary: The US Trade Representative proposed a global framework to address excess steel production capacity during G20 Trade Ministers' meetings, suggesting other countries should adopt similar measures to those the United States has implemented.

stories.title: How Hong Kong’s foreign carer scheme aims to get ahead of ageing city

en.title: How Hong Kong's foreign carer scheme aims to get ahead of ageing city
en.summary: Hong Kong's government plans to allow importation of specially qualified foreign carers to address elderly care needs. The policy proposal has generated discussion regarding its potential effects on the city's aging population challenge.

stories.title: Israel PM hails Indian pilot wounded in diverted flydubai flight

en.title: Israel PM hails Indian pilot wounded in diverted flydubai flight
en.summary: An Indian pilot of a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight was attacked by his co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash the aircraft on Wednesday. The pilot and passengers prevented the catastrophe, leading to an emergency landing, with Israeli officials characterizing the incident as an attempted terrorist attack.

stories.title: UK accuses China of using academics to spy on AI and other tech research

en.title: UK accuses China of using academics to spy on AI and other tech research
en.summary: Britain's MI5 intelligence agency warned that a Chinese organization funded by Beijing's state security service has directed over 100 UK academics to contribute to research projects in areas including artificial intelligence. The agency issued an unprecedented espionage alert regarding the arrangement.

stories.title: China slaps 55% tariff on Brazilian beef, rebuffs bid to borrow Uruguay’s quota

en.title: China slaps 55% tariff on Brazilian beef, rebuffs bid to borrow Uruguay's quota
en.summary: China imposed a 55 percent additional tariff on Brazilian beef after Brazil exhausted its annual import quota and was denied access to Uruguay's unused allocation. The surcharge took effect following Brazil's consumption of its 1.106 million-tonne allowance for 2026.

stories.title: UK-France deal targeting migrants crossing English Channel is scrapped

en.title: UK-France deal targeting migrants crossing English Channel is scrapped
en.summary: The British government terminated a pilot programme with France designed to reduce migrant crossings of the English Channel in small boats. The agreement, which involved detaining and returning arrivals to France in exchange for equivalent asylum seekers, is no longer accepting new cases.

stories.title: UK PM says ‘strong indications’ Iran involved in bomb scare at US-run airbase

en.title: UK PM says 'strong indications' Iran involved in bomb scare at US-run airbase
en.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that Iran likely played a role in suspicious activity at RAF Fairford that caused a security incident on Sunday. The airbase in southwest England is used by US military operations.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）综合消息：中国跳水队达成“百金”成就 中国男足无缘决赛

en.title: Aichi Nagoya Asian Games: Chinese diving team achieves '100 gold medals' milestone; Chinese men's football team eliminated from final
en.summary: China's diving team won two final medals at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games on September 30, reaching 100 total golds in Asian Games diving history. China's men's football team lost 1-2 to defending champion South Korea in the semifinals and will not compete in the final.

stories.title: First execution of a woman in US state of Tennessee for 200 years halted

en.title: First execution of a woman in US state of Tennessee for 200 years halted
en.summary: A US federal appeals court temporarily stopped the execution of Christa Pike in Tennessee minutes before she was to become the first woman executed in that state in over 200 years. The court paused proceedings to review her claims that childhood sexual abuse was not properly considered during sentencing.

stories.title: 沃洛金当选连任俄国家杜马主席 普京出席首次全会并讲话

en.title: Volodin re-elected as chairman of Russian State Duma; Putin attends first plenary session and delivers speech
en.summary: Volodin was re-elected as chairman of Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament. President Putin attended the first plenary session of the new Duma and spoke about lawmakers' responsibility to prioritize major state issues and ensure victory.

stories.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies

en.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies
en.summary: Hong Kong banks are offering incentives to attract mainland Chinese visitors during golden week, including cash bonuses and entertainment experiences, following Beijing's new 20 percent levy on overseas investment and insurance gains.

stories.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination

en.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination
en.summary: New World Development reported a HK$26.8 billion net loss for the year ended June, primarily due to HK$18.3 billion in impairments related to the early termination of its 11 Skies mall project.

stories.title: DFI Retail sells stake in Maxim’s in return for Starbucks business, US$340m

en.title: DFI Retail sells stake in Maxim's in return for Starbucks business, US$340m
en.summary: Maxim's Caterers is purchasing DFI Retail's stake for US$340 million and gaining control of the Starbucks licensed business, ending decades of partial ownership by conglomerate Jardine Matheson.

stories.title: Singapore beefs up rivalry with Hong Kong by picking 5 firms to boost equity market

en.title: Singapore beefs up rivalry with Hong Kong by picking 5 firms to boost equity market
en.summary: Singapore's central bank selected five international asset managers to handle S$1.45 billion in locally-focused equity strategies, as part of efforts to strengthen its stock market competitiveness against Hong Kong. The appointment represents the third batch of mandates under the Monetary Authority of Singapore's market development program.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s IPO haul in first 9 months smashes record despite Nasdaq’s fundraising lead

en.title: Hong Kong's IPO haul in first 9 months smashes record despite Nasdaq's fundraising lead
en.summary: Hong Kong IPOs raised US$48.4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, double the previous level and the highest for any comparable period since 1980. A total of 112 companies listed on the main board, with two additional listings on the Growth Enterprise Market.
